concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1, T101/T102 and 'Dependencies and requirement coverage — Order'
concerns.text: T102 is tagged [P] but reads `data/results/final_report.csv`, which is produced only by T101 (`merge_results.py`). The tasks.md itself states 'T101 and T102 are parallel (different files)' — different output files do not make them parallel-safe: T102's input is T101's output, so T102 has a hard producer-before-consumer dependency on T101. Either remove the [P] tag from T102 (or from both) or restructure so T102's verification runs after T101. An unsafe [P] tag risks the scheduler running T102 before any final_report.csv exists, triggering its own FileNotFoundError path.
